title: Workers' Cottages, Bound by South Second, Eleventh, A, & E Streets, Richmond, Wayne County, IN
notes: Significance: These one-and-a-half-story gable-roof cottages were built by and for Richmond's burgeoning working class in the 1850s and '60s.
Unprocessed Field note material exists for this structure: FN-67
